meta.title: GTSim H100 GEMM 256x256x128
meta.description: Official hand-written H100 GEMM timing graph. Intervals use native DAGNode first-issue start and completion end. No numerical GEMM execution, measured silicon transactions, or reconstructed internal memory stages. Components are active SM and native pipeline groups; idle SMs are omitted.

metrics.timingScope: Simulator::run only; excludes download, build, graph construction, and trace export
